name: Editor Waveform
description: Full-song waveform and spectrogram directly on the level editor grid.

enabled.name: Show waveform
enabled.description: Show the full-song waveform on the editor grid.

lock-to-camera.name: Lock to camera
lock-to-camera.description: Keep the waveform and spectrogram at fixed heights on screen when moving the camera.

vertical-offset.name: Vertical offset
vertical-offset.description: Grid waveform position in editor units. Negative values move it below the origin.

vertical-scale.name: Vertical scale
vertical-scale.description: Grid waveform height in editor units at full amplitude.

line-width.name: Line width (pixels)
line-width.description: Width of each waveform column, from 1 to 10 pixels.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Waveform opacity: 0 is invisible and 255 is fully opaque.

spectrogram-enabled.name: Show spectrogram
spectrogram-enabled.description: Show the main song’s frequency content alongside the waveform.

spectrogram-vertical-offset.name: Spectrogram vertical offset
spectrogram-vertical-offset.description: Center position, using the same camera-lock behavior as the waveform offset.

spectrogram-height.name: Spectrogram height
spectrogram-height.description: Total spectrogram height in editor units.

spectrogram-window-size.name: Spectrogram window size
spectrogram-window-size.description: Larger windows show finer frequency detail; smaller windows show finer timing detail.

spectrogram-frequency-scale.name: Spectrogram frequency scale
spectrogram-frequency-scale.description: 0 = linear spacing; 10 = logarithmic spacing. Intermediate values blend the two.

spectrogram-min-frequency.name: Spectrogram minimum frequency (Hz)
spectrogram-min-frequency.description: Lower frequency border. Reversed borders are sorted automatically.

spectrogram-max-frequency.name: Spectrogram maximum frequency (Hz)
spectrogram-max-frequency.description: Upper frequency border, limited by the song’s sample rate.

spectrogram-colormap.name: Spectrogram colormap
spectrogram-colormap.description: Colors representing spectral intensity, from quiet to loud.
